e.title: insurance-sensitivity
e.summary: 全局敏感性分析（burning-cost，MIT）：Sobol 指数 + Shapley 效应
e.body:
insurance-sensitivity（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）做定价模型的全局敏感性分析：Sobol 指数（快、假设独立特征）与 Shapley 效应（完整方差分解、处理相关性）——模型输出对输入的敏感性归因。对 RIAA：模型可解释性的全局视角——[[insurance-distill]]（蒸馏）的敏感性侧（哪些特征真正驱动定价）；与 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价）配套做模型诊断；理解「方差分解」归因（特征贡献的严谨方法）；定价模型治理/验证（PRA 期望）的工具。

## 同类工具
[[insurance-spatial-conformal]]、[[lakeside-mutual]]、[[lemur]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_en: Global sensitivity analysis (burning-cost, MIT): Sobol indices + Shapley effects
e.summary_hk: 全局敏感性分析（burning-cost，MIT）：Sobol 指數 + Shapley 效應
e.body_en:
insurance-sensitivity (burning-cost, PyPI, MIT) performs global sensitivity analysis of pricing models: Sobol indices (fast, assumes independent features) and Shapley effects (complete variance decomposition, handles correlations) — attributing model-output sensitivity to inputs. For RIAA: the global view of model interpretability — the sensitivity side of [[insurance-distill]] (distillation): which features truly drive pricing; with [[machine-learning-pricing]] (ML pricing) it supports model diagnosis; understand variance-decomposition attribution (a rigorous method of feature contribution); a tool of pricing-model governance/validation (PRA expectations).

## Similar tools
[[insurance-spatial-conformal]]、[[lakeside-mutual]]、[[lemur]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
